title: Jefferson Memorial

nativeAxes.z: north toward the main portico and Tidal Basin

geometryLabel: Mapped dome, colonnade envelope, individual columns, circular steps and main north stair flight. Mapped column count is incomplete. Immediate raised terrace perimeter retained.

orientationControl.basis: North-facing portico and column/circular footprints independently agree with Qualla aerials and HABS north elevation.

terrainContact.basis: North approach at the bottom of the mapped main stair flight; immediate raised terrace included, distant Tidal Basin approach and gardens excluded.

source: Protomaps/OpenStreetMap parts, Qualla photographs and NPS/HABS 1994 drawings.
notes: Map controls position and envelope, not column count or heights. The mapped front has seven columns; the photographs and NPS documentation establish eight plus four side columns. Twenty-six outer and sixteen inner columns are modeled. HABS measured heights take precedence over rounded/conflicting public statistics.
limitations: Not a survey; map quantization and photographic detail limit fine accuracy.
Immediate supporting raised terrace included; wider gardens, Tidal Basin, distant approach, undercroft and modern accessibility equipment excluded.
